spans.s:
वैंशतिक a. (की f.) Bought for
twenty.

वैनतकं A vessel for holding or
pouring out ghee (in sacrifices).

1 N. of Garuḍa; वैनतेय
इव विनतानंदनः K.;

वैनयिक^1 a. (की f.)
1
Pertaining to modesty, decorum, moral
conduct, or discipline.
--2 Enforcing
proper conduct.
--कः A
war-carriage.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170214. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: misaligned diacritic.

वैनायक a. (की f.) Belonging
to Gaṇeśa; वैनायक्यश्चिरं वो
वदनविधुतयः पांतु चीत्कारवत्यः

1 The doctrines of a
Buddhist school of philosophy.
--2
A follower of that school.

1 A slave.
--2 A
spider.
--3 An astrologer.
--4 The
doctrines of the Buddhists.
--5 A
follower of those doctrines.
--कं
The twenty-third asterism from that
under which any one is born.
